description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the NationalityService in the OrangeHRM system, testing various methods like getNationalityList, getNationalityById, deleteNationalities, and getNationalityByName.

classes.name: NationalityServiceTest
classes.description: A test class for the NationalityService, includes tests for retrieving, deleting, and querying Nationality entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test by creating a NationalityService instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Nationality entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single Nationality entity by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Tests deleting a list of Nationality entities.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Nationality entity by its name.
